content: @Alex Zughaid Who is working with me over the summer to help build some infrastructure around Physlib, has put together the bot @Physlib GitHub Bot. Currently it only does one thing, if you dm (and hopefully tag) it with /reviews it will give you a summary of the reviews which need doing on Physlib. If anyone has any suggestions of how we could improve this, or any other features we could use it for, we would be grateful to hear!
